SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE VII OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st February, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(7)/2002, dated
21‑2‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Sindh Local Government(Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from 14th February, 2002.

Addition of section 181 In Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001

SINDH LOCAL GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH LOCAL
GOVERNMENT (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE VII OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I, 21st February, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(7)/2002, dated
21‑2‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑‑
2. Addition of section 181 In
Sindh Ordinance No. XXVII of 2001.‑ In the Sindh Local Government
Ordinance, 2001, after section 181 the following new section shall be added:‑‑
"181‑A. Internal
Recall of Nazims.‑Notwithstanding anything contained in sections
24, 63 and 85 an internal recall motion against the Zila Nazim, Taluka, Town
Nazim or Union Nazim elected under this Ordinance, shall not be moved before
the 31st December, 2002".
